# Doctor
As the primary care provider within the [color=#5b97bc]Medical[/color] department, Doctors are responsible for monitoring patients, ensuring they have the required medication, and operating on patients as necessary.
## Medical System
A good understanding of how patients' bodies works is essential for saving lives and ensuring their visit to [color=#5b97bc]Medical[/color] has good outcomes.
To read up on everything medical, take a look [textlink="here" link="OffbrandMedical"]. Figuring out the details is the hardest part, and asking other [color=#5b97bc]Medical[/color] staff for guidance can be incredibly helpful.
## General Advice
The round can move fast when conflict breaks out, and there are a few things that can help to consider. - It is highly unlikely you will be able to save everyone. Some wounds are too great and when someone wants someone else dead it is almost inevitable one winds up in the morgue. - Medical is a hotspot, for Crew and Antagonists both. Keep an eye out for gunfights or grenades as you're healing. - Try to make sure the place is tidy if you have time, buildups of corpses and blood can bring with it very annoying Miasma. - Executions of suspected antagonists is expected, but watch out for [textlink="Parasites" link="Parasites"] trying to spread in the chaos when they die.
